architecture: Choose depth 1 or depth 2 exactly once from the initial public/neural episode representation, then run the frozen R2.0e policy at that fixed depth for the entire episode. The router sees initial state/context, permutation-invariant pooled action semantics, and 11 depth1/depth2 confidence/entropy/margin/uncertainty/value signals. The output head is zero-initialized so the untrained router defaults to depth 1.
training_label: Run frozen R2.0e fixed-depth-1 and fixed-depth-2 on independent clones of each train episode. Label depth2 only when depth2 solves and depth1 fails. Label depth1 when depth1 solves, including when both solve to prefer cheaper compute. Exclude both-fail episodes because routing cannot repair them. No oracle action or hidden task field is used to create routing labels.
loss: class-balanced cross entropy; weights computed from fit labels only
checkpoint_selection: lowest preregistered class-balanced validation cross entropy only
